mapper.select: SELECT id FROM is_category WHERE pid = #{parentId}

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.number, g.spec, g.brand, g.protect, g.stock, g.threshold, g.category as categoryId, c.name as categoryName,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN r.warehouse IN
#{warehouseId}
THEN r.nums ELSE 0 END ), 0) as totalStock
COALESCE(SUM(r.nums), 0) as totalStock
FROM is_goods g LEFT JOIN is_room r ON r.goods = g.id LEFT JOIN is_category c ON g.category = c.id
AND g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.goodsName}, '%')
AND g.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.goodsNumber}, '%')
AND g.spec LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.goodsSpec}, '%')
AND g.category IN
#{categoryId}
AND g.category = #{query.goodsCategoryId}
AND g.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.goodsBrand}, '%')
AND g.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.goodsCode}, '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM is_batch b WHERE b.goods = g.id AND b.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.batchNumber}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM is_batch b WHERE b.goods = g.id AND DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(b.time)) = #{query.productDate} )
AND g.batch = 1
GROUP BY g.id, c.id, c.name ORDER BY g.name
